n81f4065d2d.headline: How European gadgets end up in toxic landfills in Africa
n81f4065d2d.summary: Millions of tons of discarded European electronic devices end up illegally in Agbogblosh, near Ghana's capital Accra, creating hazardous working conditions.
n81f4065d2d.why: Electronic waste trade affects environmental and health conditions in Ghana and reflects global supply chain and regulatory challenges in e-waste management.
